description: Source code for the inter-slice scheduler in a cellular network simulation or implementation, managing resource allocation, slice prioritization, and UE (User Equipment) management within a 5G or similar system.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class managing inter-slice scheduling, resource allocation, and UE management.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler::ran_slice_sched_context
classes.description: Context for each RAN slice, including priority calculation.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::inter_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing slices, queues, and slot ring based on cell configuration.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::slot_indication
methods.description: Updates slice contexts and priority queues based on the current slot and resource grid.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the scheduler.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE, removing it from slices if needed.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from all slices.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::config_applied
methods.description: Handles configuration application for a UE, adding it to slices.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::add_impl
methods.description: Internal method to add UE and its logical channels to slices.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::fetch_ue_to_update
methods.description: Fetches UE for update if it is active and properly configured.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_slice
methods.description: Retrieves the slice instance based on logical channel configuration.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_candidate
methods.description: Generic method to get the next scheduling candidate for UL or DL.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_dl_candidate
methods.description: Gets the next downlink slice candidate.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_ul_candidate
methods.description: Gets the next uplink slice candidate.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::handle_slice_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for slice RRM policies.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_nof_used_reserved_rbs
methods.description: Calculates the number of reserved RBs used for UL or DL.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::ran_slice_sched_context::get_prio
methods.description: Calculates priority for a slice candidate based on multiple factors.
